scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @dropmeme/server && npm run build -w @dropmeme/desktop
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @dropmeme/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:shared && npm run tauri -w @dropmeme/desktop -- dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:shared && npm run tauri -w @dropmeme/desktop -- build --bundles nsis
